description: This file is a React component for the finalized persona page in a Next.js frontend. It fetches and displays a read-only view of a user's finalized persona, integrating data from local storage, backend orchestration records, and internal schemas. It includes methods for data coercion and extraction, along with UI components for rendering persona details and navigation.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard function to check if a value is a non-empty object.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Utility to convert an unknown input to an array of trimmed strings.

methods.name: coerceCareerHighlights
methods.description: Transforms various formats of career highlights input into a standardized array of CareerHighlightItems.

methods.name: extractFinalPersonaFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts the final persona data object from an orchestration record, checking multiple potential nested paths.
